card.name: Add email validation to user registration API
card.desc:
Repository: https://github.com/ErdemAslans/user-service-test
Branch: develop

Requirement:
User registration endpoint currently accepts invalid email formats. Add email format validation to the POST /users/register endpoint.

Acceptance Criteria:
- If email format is invalid, API should return HTTP 400
- Error message should be: Invalid email format
- Existing valid registration flow should continue working
- Add or update unit tests
